title: MET - Music-Induced Emotion EEG Dataset
description: The MET dataset comprises 128-channel EEG recordings (downsampled to 66 channels) from 20 participants during resting-state and music-listening conditions. Each participant underwent one resting-state session and twenty music-listening sessions, each corresponding to a distinct song lasting 130 seconds. The dataset is intended to support research on music-induced emotional responses and their neural correlates, and is organized according to the BIDS specification.
methods_description: EEG signals were originally recorded using a 128-channel EEG system at a sampling rate of 1000 Hz. After preprocessing and channel selection, 66 EEG channels are provided. Each music session included 5 seconds before onset, 120 seconds of music playback, and 5 seconds after offset.
